translation.app_subtitle: Report hazards fast. Route them automatically. Flag dengue risk before it spreads.
translation.app_description: Citizen upload, AI severity classification, department routing, and weather-based outbreak warnings in one workflow.
translation.citizen_report_desc: Upload a photo, share your location, and let the system route the issue.

water_logging.incident_report: Roads may be submerged, drains can overflow, and homes or shops may be cut off by standing water.
how_to_overcome: Switch off electricity if water is entering the area
Avoid walking or driving through flood water
Report blocked drains and damaged embankments
prevention_tips: Store important items above floor level
water_logging.emergency_note: If water is rising quickly, leave immediately and contact emergency services.

heavy_rain.incident_report: Heavy rainfall can cause waterlogging, poor visibility, slippery roads, and overflowing drains.
how_to_overcome: Slow down and avoid unnecessary travel
Use headlights and keep distance between vehicles
Clear drains before water builds up
Stay away from slopes that may fail
heavy_rain.emergency_note: If conditions worsen, stay indoors until authorities say the roads are safe.

road_damage.incident_report: The road surface may be cracked, uneven, or collapsing in sections.
how_to_overcome: Reroute traffic until the surface is safe
prevention_tips: Inspect roads after rain and heavy traffic
Keep heavy vehicles away from weak edges
road_damage.emergency_note: If the road is sinking or opening up, stop traffic and call the road authority immediately.

large_pothole.incident_report: A deep pothole can suddenly damage tyres or cause drivers to lose control.
how_to_overcome: Share the location with the road team
prevention_tips: Improve drainage around the road edge
large_pothole.emergency_note: If the pothole is deep enough to trap a wheel, block the lane until repair work is done.

tree_fallen_on_road.incident_report: The road may be blocked and power lines nearby could also be damaged.
how_to_overcome: Check for live wires before approaching
Clear the road with trained crews
Alert utility services if lines are involved
tree_fallen_on_road.emergency_note: Treat any fallen tree as a hazard until utility and road crews confirm it is safe.

tree_at_risk_of_falling.incident_report: A leaning or weak tree could fall onto a road, building, or power line.
how_to_overcome: Call arboriculture or local maintenance teams
Keep people out of the drop zone
prevention_tips: Inspect trees after strong wind and rain
Do not let people gather under the tree
tree_at_risk_of_falling.emergency_note: If the tree is already leaning heavily, evacuate the area before attempting removal.

building_collapse.incident_report: Debris, unstable walls, or a partial collapse can block roads and entrances.
how_to_overcome: Keep everyone away from the structure
Do not enter until engineers inspect it
building_collapse.emergency_note: If the structure is moving, cracking, or leaning, evacuate immediately.

fire.incident_report: Smoke, heat, and falling debris can make the area unsafe and block access routes.
how_to_overcome: Move people away from smoke and flames
Turn off gas and power if safe to do so
Do not re-enter the building until cleared
prevention_tips: Train staff and residents on evacuation
fire.emergency_note: If the fire is spreading, evacuate first and do not try to fight it alone.

burst_water_pipe.incident_report: A burst pipe can flood roads, erode soil, and disrupt the water supply.
how_to_overcome: Shut off the affected valve if possible
Send maintenance crews to isolate the leak
Check nearby road edges for erosion
burst_water_pipe.emergency_note: If the leak is undermining the road surface, stop traffic until repairs are complete.

blocked_drainage.incident_report: Standing water and overflowing drains may quickly create local flooding.
how_to_overcome: Pump out standing water where needed
prevention_tips: Clean drains before the rainy season
Keep road inlets free of waste
blocked_drainage.emergency_note: Blocked drains can turn into flooding fast, so treat repeat complaints as urgent.

illegal_waste_dumping.incident_report: Dumped waste can block drains, create bad smells, and attract pests.
how_to_overcome: Identify the dumping point for enforcement
Keep drains clear while cleanup happens
illegal_waste_dumping.emergency_note: If hazardous waste is present, use protective gear and escalate to the proper environmental team.

fallen_power_line.incident_report: Live wires on the ground can cause electrocution, fire, and major access restrictions.
how_to_overcome: Do not touch the wire or anything it is touching
Call the utility company and emergency services
Secure the road until power is isolated
prevention_tips: Report sparking or sagging wires early
Train staff to stay clear of downed lines
fallen_power_line.emergency_note: Treat every downed wire as live until the utility company confirms otherwise.

damaged_building.incident_report: Cracks, unstable walls, or a weakened roof may lead to falling debris or collapse.
how_to_overcome: Do not allow occupancy until inspected
prevention_tips: Inspect after heavy rain or earthquakes
Keep heavy loads away from weak floors
damaged_building.emergency_note: If the building is shifting or shedding debris, evacuate the area immediately.

traffic_signal_failure.incident_report: Conflicting traffic movements at an intersection can quickly cause collisions.
how_to_overcome: Deploy traffic police or temporary signage
Switch drivers to manual right-of-way control
Fix the electrical or controller fault
prevention_tips: Inspect signal power and backups regularly
Keep a repair contact list ready
traffic_signal_failure.emergency_note: If the junction is busy, provide manual control until the signal is repaired.

smoke_air_pollution.incident_report: Poor air quality and reduced visibility can make outdoor movement unsafe.
how_to_overcome: Use masks if evacuation is unavoidable
Identify and stop the smoke source where possible
smoke_air_pollution.emergency_note: If breathing becomes difficult, seek medical help and move to cleaner air immediately.

stray_animals_on_road.incident_report: Animals moving through traffic lanes can create sudden hazards for drivers and riders.
how_to_overcome: Guide the animal away safely if trained to do so
Contact animal control or local authorities
Avoid loud chasing that may panic the animal
prevention_tips: Work with local animal control teams
stray_animals_on_road.emergency_note: Do not try to grab or corner a frightened animal without support.

large_animal_on_road.incident_report: A large animal can block the lane and cause severe collisions.
how_to_overcome: Keep people away from the animal's path
large_animal_on_road.emergency_note: Large animals should only be moved by trained responders.

coastal_flooding.incident_report: Coastal roads and buildings can be inundated by seawater and evacuation may become difficult.
how_to_overcome: Protect important documents and power equipment
coastal_flooding.emergency_note: If a storm surge warning is issued, evacuate early instead of waiting for flooding.

landslide.incident_report: Soil and rocks can block roads, damage infrastructure, and trap vehicles.
how_to_overcome: Keep people away from the slope
Check for trapped persons and call rescue teams
landslide.emergency_note: If the slope is still moving, do not stand beneath it or attempt to clear it alone.

rockfall.incident_report: Rocks or debris may fall onto the road without warning.
how_to_overcome: Stop traffic near the danger zone
Clear loose material with trained crews
Warn drivers well before the hazard
rockfall.emergency_note: If rocks are still falling, keep everyone away until the slope is stable.

strong_wind.incident_report: Strong wind can blow down trees, signs, and loose debris.
how_to_overcome: Avoid parking under trees or signs
Keep people away from unsafe structures
strong_wind.emergency_note: If wind is strong enough to move objects, delay outdoor work and travel when possible.

high_waves.incident_report: Powerful waves can damage coastal infrastructure and make travel unsafe.
how_to_overcome: Keep people away from the shoreline
prevention_tips: Plan alternate routes during storm periods
high_waves.emergency_note: Do not stand on exposed coastal roads or rocks when wave warnings are active.

stagnant_water.incident_report: Standing water can become a mosquito breeding site and point to poor drainage.
how_to_overcome: Drain or treat the standing water
stagnant_water.emergency_note: Persistent standing water should be removed quickly to reduce disease risk.

rodent_infestation.incident_report: Rodents can contaminate food, damage property, and spread disease.
rodent_infestation.emergency_note: If the infestation is large, coordinate cleanup and pest control together.

chemical_spill.incident_report: Toxic material may threaten people, water, soil, and nearby buildings.
how_to_overcome: Do not touch or wash the spill without guidance
Call trained hazmat or emergency responders
chemical_spill.emergency_note: If fumes or burns are present, evacuate and call emergency services immediately.

road_construction_hazard.incident_report: Open trenches, barriers, and uneven surfaces can create a temporary traffic and pedestrian hazard.
prevention_tips: Post contact numbers for the site team
road_construction_hazard.emergency_note: If the site has open excavation, do not allow public access without barriers and warning signs.

sewage_overflow.incident_report: Overflowing sewage can contaminate roads and nearby homes and quickly become a health hazard.
how_to_overcome: Repair the sewer blockage or break
Keep people away from the overflow
sewage_overflow.emergency_note: Use protective equipment and escalate quickly if sewage is reaching homes or wells.

blocked_drain.incident_report: A blocked drain can quickly turn into local flooding and foul water buildup.
blocked_drain.emergency_note: If water is already backing up, send cleanup crews before the road surface weakens.
